paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the progression of model accuracy over a series of training epochs, comparing training and validation stages. The x-axis is labeled "Epoch" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked with intervals at every 5 epochs. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" with a linear scale from 40 to 100, featuring tick labels at intervals of 10 percent. The training accuracy is represented by a solid blue line with no specific markers. Starting at approximately 47% at epoch 0, it fluctuates to about 70% around 7 Epoch, then sharply reducing to 46% at epoch 11 and increases with fluctuation around 100% by epoch 28. The validation accuracy is indicated by a solid green line, also without markers, beginning at approximately 46% at epoch 0. It shows variations similar to the training line but climbs more gradually, peaking around 82% by epoch 28. The lines don't intersect. A legend is given top left.
